brief: An open-source, self-hosted, local-first notes app where everything is an object: pages, tasks, books, whiteboards. The mark should feel calm, warm and personal, read at 16 px, and stand apart from the purple gems, cubes and letters-in-a-box of its category.
criteria: Success: a mark that is its own (not a library icon), works as app icon and favicon, in one colour, on the app's warm light and dark backgrounds.

concepts.name: Macio
concepts.idea: A soft tile — an object — with a V cut from its top: the room your notes live in.
rationale: The tile is Vasta's object; the V cut makes it ours and names it
One radius family on every curve: soft, calm, never sharp
Its own small-size cut keeps the V open at 16 px
Warm ink and paper from the app; Vasta blue as the accent

recommendation: Macio: the tile reads as Vasta's object at every size, and the V cut gives it a name without spelling one.
next_steps: Replace the app's icon, favicon and README logo
Use the wordmark in the README and site header
Revisit the 16 px cut after seeing it in real tabs
